registry.preferred_name: Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection
support_spans: A 13-year-old boy presented with an intensely pruritic skin eruption that appeared approximately 24 hours after intensive sun exposure in spring
Serum parvovirus B19 (PVB19) IgM and IgG antibodies were detectable
PVB19 DNA was found (viral load of 0.2 PVB19 DNA copies/β-globin gene copy, or 33,438 copies/μg of isolated DNA) in lesional skin biopsy specimen, but not in the serum
